name: Maou Kourin 2 ~Doukoku no Onna Yuusha Juurin Shojo~
original_name: 魔王降臨２　～慟哭の女勇者処女蹂躙～
source:
Become the fearsome devil king who terrorizes so many kingdoms in popular JRPG games -- only this time you're assaulting them in a conquest-driven ADV + SIM style!

Expand your evil empire across the realm, taking down an all-new 13 characters from the female hero and her party to village girls, princesses and warriors.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ092211.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
成为可怕的魔王，在流行的JRPG游戏中恐吓众多王国 - 只是这一次你是以征服驱动的ADV + SIM风格攻击他们！

将你的邪恶帝国扩展到整个领域，消灭从女英雄及其队伍到乡村女孩、公主和战士的13名全新角色。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ092211.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
